analogy.rationale: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors are prodrugs activated by cellular kinases and inhibit HIV reverse transcriptase, an enzyme absent from these human cell lines; their annotated targets PNP and TERT are not canonical RT targets, so transcriptional responses should be minimal. Other antiviral classes and DNA synthesis/polymerase inhibitors share only weak mechanistic overlap.
